children: LP will indefinitely curtail OSB production at its Jasper, Texas facility and expects $4–6 million of severance and one-time costs in 2026.
LP will indefinitely curtail oriented strand board production at its Jasper, TX facility starting October 2026 due to soft demand.
Jasper has ~475 million sq ft annual OSB capacity (3/8-inch basis); curtailment aligns production with current market demand.
LP estimates approximately $4 million to $6 million of severance and other one-time costs related to the curtailment in 2026.
Company will support affected employees with job search and transition assistance and may restart capacity if market conditions improve.
